data.purpose: Read the current hash-bound residual context prepared by the function/local evaluation, every source projection needed to inspect it, the fixed template and the layered evaluation method. This is the Campaign's one creative discovery node. Copy researchTemplate as entry.py and implement only residual_research(context). Author several evidence-linked F0-F3 lenses and one bounded pure candidate program that selects immutable proposal_key values from the supplied candidate pool. Respond to the current residual graph, Pareto frontier, cumulative Library, known failures and remaining budget. Do not assign identity, alter the Goal or evidence, predict commercial QoR, launch EDA, create parallel validation arms, repeat a fixed ranking, or write Judge facts. The returned list must never exceed budget["max_candidate_proposals"]; slice or stop the loop at that exact runtime value. Include one onsite-inspiration lens as the sequential seventh strategy above the six fixed miners. It analyzes their combined evidence and, from generation two onward, must cite and respond to the current commercial frontier response. It may contribute at most budget["max_onsite_inspiration_proposals"] proposals to the same cumulative Library and the same E0 validation; it never opens a separate commercial arm. Invalid output is retained as a refusal. A later revision must answer new retained evidence, especially the hash-bound commercial frontier response. It must propose several grounded hypotheses before selecting a bounded program; Run results never auto-promote into Pack knowledge.

agent.rationale: The Pack chooser research-calibration-miss reads cell_demand_coverage_pct and, on constraint FAIL, advances algorithmRevision by the declared revisionStep of 1. The calibration Judge returned FAIL exactly as the strict guard-case Demand predicted: the single authored Cell Demand declared required_delay_ns = 0.000001 ns, no calibrated D1/D2/D4/D6/D8 drive variant can meet that arc delay, so mock_liberty_calibration_accepted is 0 while cell_demand_count stays at least 1, which is why cell-demand-feedback-available can still hold while the gate as a whole is rejected. The retained result is a typed, source-linked Cell Demand miss, not an implementation result. The correct next bounded strategy is therefore the Pack recommendation: keep the same Goal, Site and method, and revise the research strategy for the next generation with algorithmRevision advanced by exactly one from its current value of 0. No commercial QoR is claimed, no missing evidence was reinterpreted as zero, and the deliberately strict Demand remains a negative-test stimulus.
